answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Work waits on the ferrous until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the zephyr of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
